text:
Alice Chen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we've observed a repeating pattern of chat-stream timeouts that cascade into partial responses and then a reconnect storm. Need clear owners and timelines for remediation items. TL;DR: GC spike on backend host pool + LB sticky session misrouting seemed to trigger it.

Raj Patel: tagging infra + runtime. I can take ownership of the LB sticky routing audit. Will do a config sweep and two quick hypotheses to validate by EOD.

Sara Gomez: I'll own the reconnect/backoff behaviour changes in the runtime. Proposed changes: exponential backoff caps, jitter, and add a max-retries window tied to client's request TTL. I'll open a draft PR today.

Tomas Eriksson: I'll add an obserability panel to track partial-response rate, reconnect rate, and request TTL expiries per region. Wanted: a quick metric slice for sessions that saw >1 reconnect within 30s. Hoping to get this on staging in 24h.

Megan Li: Customer impact note — Support reported 6 customers hit degraded streaming for ~15-40s during the three events last week. We should sync with CS after we have timelines. Also need a short message for customers once we have mitigations.

ops-bot: Incident summary: automated runbooks triggered x3 (2024-09-05 02:13UTC, 2024-09-06 11:42UTC, 2024-09-07 19:21UTC). Top symptoms: partial responses (45% of affected sessions), reconnect storms (avg 3 reconnects/session).

Alice Chen: Action items and owners (initial):
- LB routing audit -> Raj (EOD + findings)
- Runtime backoff PR -> Sara (PR + tests by tomorrow)
- Observability dashboards -> Tomas (staging in 24h, prod in 72h)
- Customer comms draft -> Megan (wait for fixes, draft within 48h)

Raj Patel: Quick note — LB audit hypothesis A: stickiness TTL mismatch between edge and backend health checks. Hypothesis B: some backends returning 302s occasionally which the LB treats as healthy but triggers re-routing. I'll validate logs and config.

Sara Gomez: Opening TODOs in the PR:
```
- cap_backoff_ms = 5000
- base_backoff_ms = 100
- add_jitter = true
- max_retry_window_s = 20
```
Will add unit tests for handshake jitter behaviour.

Tomas Eriksson: Also proposing a lightweight alert: if partial_response_rate > 2% over 1m AND reconnect_rate > 1% over 1m, create a P1 page and tag @oncall. I can prototype rule today.

Megan Li: +1 to the alert. CS will want an SLA-impact estimate; Tomas, can you include % of requests that got partials in your dashboard?

Alice Chen: Timeline check: Raj (EOD findings), Sara (PR tomorrow + rollout plan), Tomas (staging dashboard 24h / prod 72h), Megan (customer comms draft 48h). We'll reconvene in this thread with status updates.

Raj Patel: Update 2210345800: finished initial LB config grep and found two edge pools with inconsistent stickiness TTLs. Dumping logs to /infra/elb/22103458-ttl-check.log. Will prepare a mitigation plan (flip to unified TTL) and roll in canary.

Sara Gomez: Update 2210346105: PR opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4321 (draft). Running unit tests now. Patch includes jitter + a 20s max retry window.

Tomas Eriksson: Update 2210346602: dashboard up on staging (link in monitoring). Added pane for session reconnect frequency and partial chunk counts. Early staging shows reconnects drop ~30% with Sara's patched runtime.

Megan Li: Update 2210346802: drafted customer note summarizing the issue and planned mitigations. Will hold off sending until we confirm prod rollout schedule.

Alice Chen: Thanks all. Later this week we'll decide on permanent mitigations (LB config + runtime defaults) and whether we need a long-term change (e.g., sticky session redesign). If anyone hits blockers, drop brief updates here. :thumbsup:
